summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on the phase-39 branch (PR #423) for user-configurable vault parameters, then handle follow-up issues including a CI test failure, lockfile security concern, and additional review rounds.
summary.outcome: All 11 review threads across 3 review rounds were resolved; 9 code/doc fixes implemented and pushed; axios version pinned to 1.8.2 in lockfile; dead bin store retentionDays field removed; CI test failure fixed.

repo: cipher-box is a monorepo with packages/core, packages/crypto, apps/web, apps/desktop, apps/tee-worker managed by pnpm workspaces
TEE IPNS key enrollment follows the StorageTab.tsx pattern — wrap key before createAndPublishIpnsRecord
Vault settings (including recycleBinRetentionDays) are now the single source of truth via useVaultSettingsStore; useBinStore.retentionDays was a stale parallel write path
The phase-39 branch was cut before phase-38 completion commit (560c871fe) was merged, causing vault-ipns.test.ts to have a @cipherbox/core circular dep import that was already fixed on phase-38
pnpm lockfile formatting (inline vs expanded YAML) changes on merge due to the branch having a different lockfile base than main — functionally identical, cosmetically noisy
axios 1.13.2 was manually pinned (removing ^ caret) in response to a poisoned version published 2026-03-31
Planning docs live at .planning/phases/39-*/39-*.md and need to be kept in sync with implementation changes (e.g. retention range 1-365 → 0-365)

code.finding: recycleBinRetentionDays min was 1; changed to 0 per design requirement D-03 allowing indefinite retention disable
setTimeout for debounced save had no cleanup on unmount — fixed with useRef to hold the timer ID and a cleanup in useEffect
retentionDays now sourced directly from useVaultSettingsStore instead of useBinStore, eliminating stale state
retentionDays field and setRetentionDays setter fully removed — no consumers read from it after useBin.ts was fixed
useBinStore.getState().setRetentionDays() call was a redundant stale write after useBin.ts started reading from vault settings store directly
Pre-existing @cipherbox/core import caused resolution failure; fixed by replacing with inline test vectors matching the fix already on phase-38 branch
Test asserted clamp(0) => 1 (old min=1 behavior); needed update to expect 0 after min was lowered — this caused the CI failure
New test file created for deriveVaultSettingsIpnsKeypair (5 tests) — split from vault-ipns.test.ts to avoid the pre-existing import resolution issue
Missing TEE IPNS key enrollment before createAndPublishIpnsRecord — added teeKeys wrapping following StorageTab pattern

workflow: When a branch is cut before a sibling branch's fixes are merged, cherry-pick or rebase early to avoid re-solving the same issues
After merging main, verify STATE.md and ROADMAP.md planning files weren't overwritten with stale state from main
Separate new tests into their own file when the existing test file has a pre-existing import resolution failure to keep CI green
pnpm install after a merge that causes lockfile formatting churn will regenerate the canonical format, but a squash-merge to main also resolves it naturally
Verify all code findings against current code before implementing — some reviewer comments may already be addressed in earlier commits on the same branch

friction: vault-ipns.test.ts had a pre-existing @cipherbox/core circular dep import failure that blocked running new tests — required investigating git history across branches to find the fix
Merging main caused 15k-line lockfile diff churn (YAML formatting difference between branch and main), causing confusion about whether it was meaningful
STATE.md was overwritten by the main merge with stale phase-38 state, requiring manual correction
3-way merge conflict across ROADMAP.md, vault-ipns.test.ts, and useBin.ts required per-file resolution strategy
CI test failure (vault-settings.test.ts:54) only discovered after push — the existing test asserting old min=1 behavior wasn't caught locally because it was in a different package
pnpm lint:fix run mid-session interrupted the commit flow; a second run produced no changes, suggesting the first run's output was already committed or was a no-op
open_items: VaultTab.tsx preset buttons (thread 5) deliberately not implemented — reviewer flagged them as missing but it was a conscious simplification for this phase
useAuth.ts API endpoint for setting retention days marked not-applicable but reviewer raised deprecation concern — client-side-only decision not yet formally documented
apps/desktop has unmet peer dependency warnings for @typescript-eslint packages (eslint v8 vs v9) — pre-existing, not introduced this session
pnpm lockfile YAML formatting inconsistency between branch and main will recur on future merges until a pnpm version alignment is enforced across the team
deriveByoConfigIpnsKeypair and deriveVaultKeyIpnsKeypair sibling functions still have no unit tests — only deriveVaultSettingsIpnsKeypair was covered this session
